name: cloudflare-email
description: Cloudflare Email Service (beta): outbound sending + inbound routing for a domain, via the REST API
instructions: Reads the Cloudflare API through `../cloudflare-api`. Reuses CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from secrets.yaml, but the token needs extra scopes: Zone > Email Routing Rules: Edit, Zone > Zone Settings: Edit (the routing enable/settings/DNS endpoints require it), Zone > DNS: Edit, Account > Email Sending: Edit, and Account > Email Routing Addresses: Edit. Email Sending requires a Workers Paid plan (API error 10105 = not entitled). Caveats: the service is in public beta with unpublished rate limits (pilot before high-volume use); outbound messages are capped at 5 MiB total; onboarding adds an SPF record, so if the domain already has one you must merge them manually (two SPF records break SPF); 'forward' destinations require a manual email-click verification — apply sends the verification email, then fails with instructions until you click it and re-run.
